name: Vikunja
description: Self-hosted task management — projects, kanban boards, due dates, labels, and team collaboration
author: Crow

env_vars.name: VIKUNJA_API_TOKEN
env_vars.description: API token from Vikunja Settings > API Tokens

env_vars.name: VIKUNJA_ENABLE_REGISTRATION
env_vars.description: Crow turns this off after it creates your account; set true only to let people sign themselves up

firstAdmin.note: If you made Vikunja's account before this version, turn registration off: set VIKUNJA_ENABLE_REGISTRATION=false on its Extensions card and press Restart.

notes: Self-host via Docker (uses built-in SQLite) or connect to existing (set VIKUNJA_URL + VIKUNJA_API_TOKEN). Crow creates the account `admin` at install (password in Settings → Passwords) and then closes registration; add more people from Vikunja's own admin tools. API tokens live under Settings > API Tokens. The compose derives Vikunja's public URL from VIKUNJA_URL.
